findings.requirement: REQ-112 (description, paragraph «The stage scene»: the frame sentence; criterion 5)
findings.point: а and б (AP-016, AP-055: the text and the measure it names read two ways)
findings.where: Description: «after the first frame a frame is drawn only during a walk that a tap started, or after a change of the theme, the language or the size of the page»; criterion 5: «a tap starts one walk of «Вы» to the desk the step table names for that step, and only then frames are drawn».
findings.problem: The look in the tree (docs/design/V1-public-look.md sha256 3dea2340…9347, rework 03e, its §10 «Frames, one rule» and 9.13, G5) has a third case: «a tap that changes the state with no walk — «Вы» stands where the step table sends it (the fifth answer or «<enough…>» on question 5, a result chip of question 5 and the return from it to the result): one frame with the new state, the camera at its new offset at once», and 9.13 calls it «no walk: one frame»; it also says «a tap whose state equals the drawn one (9.13): no frame». Read literally, the description allows no frame on the fifth answer, so the light change from «desk 4 1, others 0» to «desk 4 1, others .25» (9.11, 9.13) would never be drawn; read as a walk of length zero with its one last frame (the author's default, step 01c issue I2) it agrees with the look. No criterion is red on a page built to the look: criterion 5 bounds the frames to after taps and asks no frame for every tap, and criterion 8 judges the look. The outcome stays; the code design and the test design read «no walk» in one text and «only during a walk» in the other.
findings.fix: Name the look's three cases in the description sentence (a tap that changes the state with no walk: one frame; a tap to the drawn state: no frame; a change of theme, language or size: one frame) and give criterion 5 a row «a tap whose target is where «Вы» stands and whose state differs draws exactly one frame with no position between; a tap to the drawn state draws none», with the mutant «no frame on a state change with no walk». Where: a WF-01 micro-amendment of REQ-112 before the code design of M1.4 (the wording of step 01c issue I2 fits); until then ORCH records the reading in decisions/0123 under О15.

findings.requirement: REQ-111 (criterion 12, the overflow rule written for N3)
findings.point: а (AP-153, AP-162: a check whose reach leaves out one way to hide what it proves)
findings.where: Criterion 12: «no element with its own visible text — a child text node that is not only white space, `checkVisibility()` true — whose scrollWidth exceeds its clientWidth, the visually hidden elements of the look description's `.sr` rule … and their descendants left out».
findings.problem: Measured in headless Chrome 157.0.8103.79 on a trial page outside the project (home and profile in the session scratch folder): an inline element reports scrollWidth 0 and clientWidth 0, so the rule never reads one; a box whose text stands only in inline children has no own text, so it is not read either, while its text is cut — a 60-px nowrap div holding a span: scrollWidth 237 above clientWidth 60, rule green; a 60-px inline-block button holding a span: 185 above 56, green; a 60-px div holding a link: 205 above 60, green; the control, the same text as the div's own text: 191 above 60, red. So a cut label of a button or a card whose words sit in a span or b passes the e2e test. The rework closed the two false reds of N3 (the .sr boxes, the stage) and left this way of hiding a cut text. Low: the rule as written is testable and a page built to the look passes it; the look forbids cut text («It wraps at spaces, never cut», «a label is never cut»), DESIGN-QA (criterion 15) and the UAT matrix (criterion 13) see the screen, and for the plates and «Вы» REQ-112 criterion 6 reads the label box itself.
findings.fix: Read, for every visible text node that is not only white space, its nearest ancestor whose computed display is not inline, with the .sr elements and their descendants left out as now: in the same probe this reads the three cut boxes, and the stage stays out (it holds only the canvas and the label layer, look 7.4, so no text node has it as that ancestor). Where: a WF-01 micro-amendment of REQ-111 criterion 12 before the test design of M1.4 (a test stricter than its criterion is not the fix, AP-159 item 3), or ORCH's reading in decisions/0123.

findings.point: а (AP-016: the moment of a check not named, against the look)
findings.where: Criterion 6: «in every language no label is cut (its scrollWidth not above its clientWidth) and no two labels overlap (their boxes)».
findings.problem: The moment is not named. The look reads it «when «Вы» stands, not during a walk» (9.7: at 390×844 the «Вы» label, 140–162 px, and the plates, 136–152 and two lines to 162, share a band, so during a walk the label passes under each plate it crosses, as in the sample; §14 «labels at rest, F11»). The sample's shot stock-390-light-05-ask5 shows the orange label partly under the plate «3 · СПЕЦИФИКАЦИЯ» (opened by me). A test that samples the boxes during a walk at 390×844 is red on a page built to the look; read at rest, as the look reads it, the criterion holds.
findings.fix: Add «when «Вы» stands (at load and after each walk)» to the sentence. Where: the same REQ-112 micro-amendment as V1, or ORCH's reading in decisions/0123.

findings.point: а (a value the test needs is not named)
findings.where: Criterion 4: «A palette colour that is not #rrggbb, and a strength that is not a number from 0 to 1, is replaced by a neutral constant with no exception».
findings.problem: No constant is named, in the criterion or in the look (a search of the look for «neutral» finds nothing), so the test has no oracle for «replaced»: it can assert no exception and that the bad value reaches no fillStyle, not that the replacement is the one meant. The same sentence stood at passes 1 and 2 (step 01c, before_copy).
findings.fix: Name the replacement (a colour of the look's constants, or a value the code design names) and what the test asserts: no exception; no fillStyle holds the bad value; the fills that would carry it carry the named colour; a bad strength gives the light layer the named alpha. Where: the code design of M1.4 names it in its test table, or one phrase in the micro-amendment of V1.

findings.where: Fact (10): «The rule of criterion 9, sketched: 10 planted lines red, 6 twins green, no hit in layout.js or office-sim.js».

My sketch of the rule as worded (blanking of comments, strings and template text; whole identifiers; `/api` on the raw text with its borders): 10 of 10 planted lines red, 7 of 7 twins green, no hit in layout.js or office-sim.js. The author's issue I3 of step 01c says the same.
findings.fix: Write 7 twins. Where: DOC-UPDATER under decisions/0079 item 5 (a number, the meaning unchanged), or the next micro-amendment.
